title: Fractional Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory for a Superdiffusive Ginzburg-Landau dynamics
summary: We investigate a boundary-driven Ginzburg-Landau dynamics with long-range interactions. In the hydrodynamic limit, the macroscopic evolution is governed by a fractional heat equation with Dirichlet boundary conditions, while the corresponding stationary profile is characterized by a fractional Laplace equation. We establish a dynamical large deviations principle for the empirical measure and derive the associated stationary large deviations principle for the non-equilibrium steady state, which can be computed semi-explicitly.
